notes: Bench Piglet for pi-arena (the aot arm): the ten bench-ext TypeScript extensions are embedded in the Binary and the aot runtime (Go, fused) compiles them into a slot image at first start (Pi-Bolt 0.7.4, downloaded on first use and signature-checked) and runs the image from the next start. Run with PIG_TS_RUNTIME=aot. The image is not part of the Binary. Experimental. Pin it by Pigpen commit (fixed release.version) until PiG 0.5.0 ships, then by its pi-in-go.dev version.
